serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Shanice: Oh, you are already here. Good.
You: Yeah. Why did you want me to come?
Shanice: Right, I wanted to talk about your sexbot. Did you learn anything new about her in the meantime?
You: No, not really. Why do you ask?
Shanice: When I met the two of you on the street the other day I came up with an idea how to learn more about her. 
Shanice: You see, every one of the newer sexbots had a gps module build-in just in case. If your sexbot has a similar module installed maybe we could be able to learn where she came from.
You: We can try if you want.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceHappy
Shanice: Great! 
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
Shanice: I will come by soon to do the work. Ask your lady if it’s ok first. Ok? I will not come if she doesn’t agree. I respect your privacy after all.
You: Sure. That’s very nice of you. 
Shanice: Before you leave, do you need any repairs?
